title: TrustGate rag_context v1
description: The retrieval declaration carried at trustgate_metadata.rag_context. It declares ONLY the documents actually bound into the prompt sent to the model — never earlier retrieval stages (candidate sets, rerank inputs, discarded hits), which is why this contract has no 'stages' field and no per-document 'stage'.

corpus.description: Identifier of the corpus/index the documents were retrieved from.

query.description: The retrieval query that produced these documents.

source.description: What produced this declaration. Unknown values are invalid: a new integration adds a value here in an additive v1 change.

docs.description: The documents bound into the prompt, in the order they were bound.

id.description: Stable identifier of the document within the corpus.

score.description: Retrieval score as the store reported it. Stores use different scales (cosine, dot product, BM25, distance) — do NOT assume 0-1. JSON has no NaN/Infinity literal, so any parseable value here is finite.

preview.description: The document text as bound into the prompt, truncated by the caller if longer than the cap.

source_uri.description: Where the document came from, for provenance.

hash.description: Lowercase or uppercase hex digest of the document body.
